label: molecules
quotes: Card
Card is a title and its explanation, with an optional ordinal.
CaseItem
CaseItem is a portfolio case: the photo, and over it the name and the sentence, anchored at the bottom on a veil.
Footer
Footer closes the page: the brand with its tagline, the columns of links, the networks and the signature.
Grid
Grid is the twelve-column grid of the system, with the two gutters, and its two five-up layouts.
Lists
SimpleList is a centered list without bullets: the air separates the items.
Menu
Menu is the desktop navigation bar: the logo on one side, the destinations in the middle, and an optional end slot (the theme toggle) that is not a destination.
Metric
Metric is a figure in a box: the number big, what it measures in gray, the change in bold.
Question
Question is a question and its answer under a hairline: the Q&A of a decision tree.
Screenshot
Screenshot is a capture of a screen: fixed height, whole image, rounded corners.
Section
Section is a band of the page: the background reaches edge to edge and the content stays in the column.
SectionHeader
SectionHeader opens a section: title and lead.
Stack
Stack puts the pieces of a stop one under the other with the system's air between them: a header over a grid, a row of metrics over its note, a few questions in a column.
